BurntToast (Chocapic13' Shaders edit) v0.1.5

- Disable vegetation/fire waving by default in Default and Fast profiles.
- Keep all waving options available, with speed/strength defaults of 1.0.
- Keep water waves and ripples off by default.
- Retain v0.1.4 hand-edge motion-blur protection and End lighting/sky fixes.
- Clarify Litematica compatibility: no explicit patch found in the supplied Sildur
  archive; blurry ghost textures occur there too. Iris issue #2974 proposes
  ChunkFix uniform-buffer support but has no posted fix or workaround.

Install BurntToast_v0.1.5_.Chocapic13_Toaster_edit.zip and select it in Iris.
Target: Minecraft 26.2 / Iris 1.11.4. Visual testing remains with the user.
